CustomField.description: Sales tax collected on this order. This is money held in trust for the state, NOT income: it is part of Amount Gross because the buyer paid it, but it belongs in a liability account and must be remitted. Do not treat it as revenue in any report. Zero on an exempt or out-of-state order, and zero is a real answer - a blank means no tax was ever calculated.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Sales tax collected. Held in trust for the state - not income.
CustomField.label: Tax Amount
